    What the calls say so far

    National backdrop

    Why more is coming. Delinquency is concentrated in office and now multifamily. Industrial barely registers in CMBS, which is why industrial distress has to be found at the county level.

    CMBS 30+ day delinquency by property type · Sept 2026 · Trepp
    • 9.66%US CMBS distress if you count loans past maturity that still pay interest. That gap is the "extend and pretend" book.
    • 8.04%Multifamily delinquency, now above the overall rate for the first time since the Covid shutdowns.
    • ~3%Orlando's CMBS distress rate in July 2026 (CRED iQ), one of the lower readings among top-50 metros. Florida distress is spotty, not uniform.

    Sourcing playbook

    CMBS data catches big loans. Small-bay and flex owners usually borrow from local banks, so their distress shows up in county records first. Here is the Florida foreclosure clock and where to watch each step.

    Florida judicial foreclosure clock · typical timing
    Earliest · months before sale

    Lis pendens

    Recorded in county Official Records when a lender files foreclosure. Search document type "LP", then keep commercial parcels. The owner still controls the sale and now has a deadline.

    Filed case · statewide

    Public notices

    Florida requires foreclosure and sale notices to be published, and floridapublicnotices.com collects them statewide. Search "foreclosure" plus a city to catch counties you don't watch daily.

    Judgment · weeks before sale

    Auction calendars

    Clerks run foreclosure sales online. A commercial parcel on the calendar means a final judgment exists. Owners can still sell before the sale date, and many will take a fast, certain close.

    Tax distress · yearly cycle

    Tax certificates

    Florida property taxes go delinquent April 1 and certificates sell by June 1. An owner who let a commercial parcel's taxes lapse is short on cash. Two years later a holder can apply for a tax deed.

    Filter · property appraiser

    Use codes

    Every Florida parcel carries a DOR use code. Check it on the appraiser site to keep only industrial and flex before you dial.

    4100 light mfg4800 whse <20K SF4801 whse 20K to 100K4816 flex1907 whse condo

    Opening line

    For an owner with a recorded lis pendens. Lead with certainty of close, never with the filing.

    "I buy small industrial and flex buildings in your area and can close quickly with no financing contingency. If timing or certainty on a sale would help you right now, I'd like to make you an offer this week."

    How this works

    • Fit (0 to 100) checks type, market and loan size against your buy box. Motivation (0 to 100) starts from the stage and adds for sponsor stress, a peak-vintage loan or purchase, a reported value drop and a recent event. Priority blends the two, weighted 55/45 toward fit.
    • Loan tapes. Every CMBS trust files a monthly loan tape (Form ABS-EE) with SEC EDGAR. This page reads the newest tape from each of 384 trusts, filed through 16 Oct 2026, and keeps Florida loans that mature by 2027, are delinquent or in special servicing, or are industrial. Pari passu pieces of one loan held by several trusts are combined; defeased loans are dropped.
    • Refi gap = balance minus the loan the building's latest NOI supports at the chosen rate, a 30-year amortization and 1.25x DSCR. Portfolio loans that include properties outside Florida aren't scored, because the tape's cash flow covers only part of the collateral.
    • County records. For Hillsborough and Duval industrial parcels (DOR 041, 048, 049, 5,000 to 150,000 SF, entity owners) I searched the owner names in the Clerk's Official Records and kept recorded mortgages, lis pendens, liens, judgments, modifications and assignments. A lis pendens counts only when the owner is the defendant. Owner-granted assignments of rents, SBA 504 and CDC second liens, ACG's own entities and individual owners without a lis pendens are left out. Each field is tagged Recorded (read from a public record) or Estimated (my assumption).
    • What is estimated. The index shows no loan amount or maturity, so the due date is the date the mortgage was signed (recorded) plus the term you pick in the filters, 5 years by default, and loan size is 65% of assessed value. Lender health comes from FDIC call reports for 30 Jun 2026; credit unions and private lenders have none. A bank that has since merged is shown with its successor's figures or marked as having no active record.
    • Duval specifics. 1,452 Duval owners were searched in the Duval Clerk's Official Records (2016 onward). Duval shows the face amount on each mortgage, so loan size there is recorded, not estimated. A mortgage counts as open unless a satisfaction or release from the same lender was recorded after it. A Duval lis pendens counts as a foreclosure only when the plaintiff is a lender; government and contractor suits are listed but not staged. Notices of tax deed sale (taxes unpaid 2+ years) are a hard signal. Judgments the owner won against others are read as tenant trouble.
    • Every other county is a parcel lead. For the other 65 counties the leads come from the Florida Department of Revenue statewide parcel roll (industrial use codes 041, 048 and 049, 5,000 to 150,000 SF, company owners, institutional and national companies removed), ranked by sell likelihood and matched to Sunbiz: up to 120 per county around Tampa Bay, Orlando, Jacksonville and Lakeland, and up to 50 elsewhere. Loans and filings for these counties have not been searched, except Manatee and Pasco (below). Many clerks bar automated searches or use a CAPTCHA (Orange, Polk, Highlands, Sarasota, Marion, Osceola, Miami-Dade, and every county on the Landmark Web system); those wait on Reonomy or a manual check.
    • Crexi export (Nov 2026). 1,000 Crexi property records for Florida industrial, 5,000 to 150,000 SF, with a loan maturing within two years. Where Crexi lists the loan's actual term and the loan matches the county mortgage, its maturity date replaces the assumed-term estimate (tagged Crexi). Loans signed before 2010 with a term over 20 years are ignored: Crexi adds the term to the signing date and doesn't check payoffs, so those are almost always paid off. Crexi also adds the interest rate, fixed or floating where listed, loan type, pre-foreclosure filings, USPS vacancy, and tenants (shown only when the owner looks like an owner-user). Properties not already here were added only with a distress signal (pre-foreclosure, floating rate, vacancy, balloon, seller or private loan) or at least two sell signals (owner-user, held 12+ years, out-of-state owner, older building), after dropping institutional and national owners.
    • Manatee and Pasco specifics. All 240 parcel-lead owners in these two counties were searched by name in the clerk's official records (Nov 2026), using the same rules as Duval: a mortgage counts as open unless a satisfaction or release from the same lender was recorded after it, and only the three newest open loans are kept. Manatee shows the face amount on each mortgage. Pasco's index does not, so Pasco loan sizes are estimated at 65% of assessed value. The lender name sets the loan type (bank, credit union, private, insurer, SBA); fixed or floating is never on the recorded mortgage.
    • What is not covered. Delinquent property taxes are not pulled automatically: each lead links to the tax collector and has a box to tick. Sunbiz matches are by exact owner name; where several entities share the name, the active one is used, and owners with no exact match show none.
    • Verified 26 Oct 2026. Every county-record lead was re-checked against the Florida Department of Revenue 2026 parcel roll by folio (square feet, year built, assessed value, address and owner mailing address all matched), and every owner was re-checked on Sunbiz. Owner-occupied means the owner's mailing or Sunbiz principal address is the building itself.
    • Reported cases come from 2026 news coverage, checked against each article and linked in each case file. Tape loans are pinned at the county, not the exact parcel; county-record leads are pinned at the parcel.
    • Pipeline notes and added leads are saved with this page and shared with anyone you give edit access. Your buy box stays in your own browser.
